public_rationale: Musk publicly explained the term in a 2023 CNBC interview, identifying it with the arrival of AGI and the difficulty of predicting what follows. One such example defeats 'none' under the ordinary reading of 'defined.' This finding concerns the public record, not Marcus's private knowledge or the truth of the CEOs' singularity claims.
limitations: The result depends on counting an ordinary explanation as a definition.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: As far as Marcus knows, none of the CEOs claiming the singularity has defined what they mean by it.

statement.excerpt: Another reason not to take the whole lot of them seriously is that, so far as I know, none of them has actually defined what they mean.
statement.document_title: Sorry, Sam and Elon, we have not reached the Singularity

from_speaker: has actually defined what they mean
our_interpretation: Assess the public-record assertion about the referenced CEOs, not Marcus's private knowledge.
An ordinary verbal explanation of what singularity means counts as a definition. A numerical threshold or formal test is not required by his words.
The retrospective wording covers public explanations before July 28, 2026, including earlier statements by the same CEOs.
criteria.support_condition: A sufficiently comprehensive review of the referenced CEOs' public statements finds no explanation of what they mean by singularity.
criteria.contradiction_condition: At least one referenced CEO publicly explained what singularity means before July 28, 2026.
